title: Did the Peltola Campaign Seal the Fate of Alaska’s Ranked Choice Vote?
summary: Beyond hotly contested Senate and governor’s races, Alaskans will decide Tuesday whether to scrap the state’s unique ballot. The campaign of Mary Peltola may have bolstered critics of the system.
